[SWS_DM_00933] UDS DTC status bit 5 / ’testFailedSinceLastClear’ after displacement
⌈
If
an
event
memory
entry
was

placement AND the configuration parameter DiagnosticCommonProps.status-
BitHandlingTestFailedSinceLastClear is set to statusBitAgingAndDis-
